proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: types.ts defines no magic_item UnitRecord kind. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but there is no MagicItemRecord type, no magic_item mechanics family, and no tracer branch for kind='magic_item'. Every magic item hits this wall before any atom-level question can be asked.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Kind: magic_item (unit header — Wondrous Item, Rare)

proposed_widenings.name: dawn reset cadence
proposed_widenings.justification: The item recharges 'until the next dawn.' The current RestResetCadence variants are short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, and partial_short_full_long. None of these cover a time-of-day-based reset. Dawn recharge is a distinct cadence found on many magic items and is unrepresentable in the current type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: post-teleport trigger window + environmental obscurement effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary mechanic fires after the Dimension Door teleport resolves and creates a Lightly Obscured zone at the origin space lasting until end of next turn. This requires: (1) a post-teleport trigger window (not in current window atoms in types.ts), and (2) an environmental area effect (Lightly Obscured) that is not damage, healing, or any existing Effect variant. The v4 taxonomy has create_object but it is absent from types.ts Effect types.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is Lightly Obscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

notes: Primary blocker is the missing MagicItemRecord kind — identical to magic_item_bag_of_beans. Secondary blockers: (1) 'next dawn' reset cadence has no variant in RestResetCadence; (2) the smoke cloud aftermath requires a post-teleport trigger and an environmental obscurement effect, neither of which exist in current surface types. The core teleport mechanic (Dimension Door) is itself a well-understood spell; the item's unusual aspect is that it grants one daily use of that spell as a Magic action — which maps to grant_spell_access + charge/use_count + dawn_reset once a magic_item family exists.
